sources.setup: plain BDS 1.26.51 on a slot, superflat survival world, difficulty easy, mob spawning off and mobs killed; three moving bds-sweep-client players: Subject at (0.5,-60,0.5), Viewer at (3.5,-60,4.5) and Far at (120.5,-60,0.5) (out of the send range); a glass pool (water x 14..26, y -63..-56, z -6..6); Subject walks, sprints (key held from rest, released while running, then forward released), jumps, sprint-jumps, sneaks (vanilla flags, then round-2's raw flags), sprint-swims in the pool, asks to swim on land and to glide on the ground (elytra by /replaceitem), then glides from y -30 with an elytra (script tools/bds-sweep player_script.py, orders move/look/sprint/sneak/jump/glide/press)

same world; naturalregeneration off; stone floor x 38..70, z -3..3 at y -61; Subject teleported above landing blocks and falling: stone from 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 10 and 12.5 blocks, 2-deep water, a hay bale, slime, a bed (top at -59.4375), 2-deep powder snow from 10 blocks, slime while sneaking, and stone from 10 blocks with Feather Falling IV diamond boots (enchanted in hand, equipped through the inventory); instant health between falls; Viewer at (50.5,-60,6.5)

same world; naturalregeneration off; Subject walks, sprints, jumps three times, sprint-jumps, sneak-walks, sprint-swims and walks in the pool (exhaustion attribute every tick), stands 4 s in a fire block on netherrack at (40,-60,0) and burns out, is teleported into lava for 3 s and dies there, then takes two /damage 1 entity_attack hits from Viewer standing 3 blocks east (knockback)

packets: hex of the packet header and payload (no length prefix), as recorded by client_diff; inputs are the subject's PlayerAuthInput packets of the phase

walk.subject: Subject
walk.note: Walking 1 s from rest, then letting go: MOVING on with the first move (0.098), off when a tick moves less than sqrt(0.001) (0.0192 after 0.0351).

walk_viewer.subject: Subject
walk_viewer.note: The same walk as Viewer saw it: the same flag updates and one MovePlayer per input.

sprint.subject: Subject
sprint.note: Sprint key held from rest, then forward pressed: StartSprinting accepted at once (SPRINTING, then movement 0.13 with the sprint modifier and the tick's exhaustion, then MOVING); the key released while running sends nothing (the sprint lasts); forward released: StopSprinting, SPRINTING off and movement 0.1; sprint exhaustion 0.1 per horizontal block every tick.

sprint_viewer.subject: Subject
sprint_viewer.note: The same sprint as Viewer saw it: flags, movement and every exhaustion update reach the viewer too.

jump.subject: Subject
jump.note: One standing jump: MOVING on at the jump, off at the apex (0.003), on again falling, off on landing; exhaustion +0.05.

sprint_jump.subject: Subject
sprint_jump.note: A sprint started with a jump on the next tick: exhaustion 0.2 for the jump and no distance that tick, nothing in the air.

sneak.subject: Subject
sneak.note: Sneak with the vanilla flags (StartSneaking, Sneaking, SneakDown and the raw sneak flags): the flag word with height 1.49, then the second word with BLOCKING and TRANSITION_BLOCKING; sneak-walking sets MOVING; StopSneaking: the flag word with 1.8, then the second word without BLOCKING.

sneak_viewer.subject: Subject
sneak_viewer.note: The same sneak as Viewer saw it.

sneak_raw.subject: Subject
sneak_raw.note: Round 2's raw flags (StartSneaking and Sneaking, then Sneaking and SneakDown held, no raw sneak flags): a resync (flag words and key 139) first, the sneak a tick late with the old second word and 139, and another resync after the stop.

swim.subject: Subject
swim.note: Sprinting in the pool: StartSprinting and StartSwimming accepted together (SPRINTING, SWIMMING and height 0.6, movement 0.13); forward released: SWIMMING off with height 1.8, the second word and key 139, then SPRINTING off a tick later with the same rows.

swim_dry.subject: Subject
swim_dry.note: StartSwimming on land: refused with the unchanged flag words and key 139.

glide_ground.subject: Subject
glide_ground.note: StartGliding standing on the ground with an elytra: refused with the unchanged flag words and key 139.

glide.subject: Subject
glide.note: Falling from y -30 with an elytra, StartGliding with a jump press: GLIDING and height 0.6; landing (StopGliding): GLIDING off and 1.8.

fall_3.subject: Subject
fall_3.note: A 3-block fall onto stone: no damage.

fall_10_viewer.subject: Subject
fall_10_viewer.note: The same fall as Viewer saw it: the hurt event, fall.big and the landing block's fall sound, and the health attribute; the falling player itself gets no fall sound.

hay_10.subject: Subject
hay_10.note: 10 blocks onto a hay bale: no damage (distance x 0.2 is under 3).

slime_10.subject: Subject
slime_10.note: 10 blocks onto slime: no damage, bounces.

bed_10.subject: Subject
bed_10.note: 9.4375 blocks onto a bed: 2 damage (distance x 0.5 - 3, rounded up).

powder_snow_10.subject: Subject
powder_snow_10.note: 10 blocks into powder snow: no damage; freezing (key 120 up by 1/140 a tick) slows the movement attribute by 0.05 x the freezing.

slime_sneak_10.subject: Subject
slime_sneak_10.note: 10 blocks onto slime while sneaking: no damage either.

feather_falling_10.subject: Subject
feather_falling_10.note: 10 blocks onto stone in Feather Falling IV boots: 3.64 damage (7 less 48 %).

sprint_exhaustion.subject: Subject
sprint_exhaustion.note: Sprinting 2 s: 0.1 per horizontal block, an update every tick.

sprint_jumps_exhaustion.subject: Subject
sprint_jumps_exhaustion.note: Sprint-jumping: 0.2 per jump and no distance on its tick, nothing in the air, the landing tick's distance at 0.1 per block.

swim_exhaustion.subject: Subject
swim_exhaustion.note: Sinking, then sprint-swimming in the pool: 0.01 per block moved in any direction.

water_walk_exhaustion.subject: Subject
water_walk_exhaustion.note: Walking in water without sprinting: 0.01 per block moved too.

fire.subject: Subject
fire.note: 4 s in a fire block, then burning out: a hit every 10 ticks in the fire (fire or fire_tick), fire_tick every 20 ticks after, ONFIRE off 160 ticks after leaving.

lava.subject: Subject
lava.note: In lava: 4 lava damage every 10 ticks, ONFIRE two ticks after the first hit; death after five hits.

push.subject: Subject
push.note: Two /damage hits from Viewer: SetActorMotion (-0.4, 0.4, 0) and the hurt, MOVING the tick after the push, off once the player stops.
